transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you lately that brought you in today?
Um… I guess I came in because I’ve just felt down for a long time. Like this heavy, flat feeling most days, even when things at work are fine or people are being nice. I still feel kind of empty.
Has this feeling of being down or flat stayed with you most days, or have there been significant periods where you felt better?

Yeah… it’s been there most days. I might have moments where I’m distracted or things seem okay, but that flat, heavy feeling doesn’t really go away for long. Even when work is fine or people are nice, I still feel kind of down and empty.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you once found pleasurable?
I’m not really sure. I mean… I still do some things, but I don’t know if I’d say I enjoy them the way I’m supposed to. It’s kind of hard to tell.
Can you think of a time recently when you felt genuinely interested or took pleasure in something you used to enjoy?
I don’t know… nothing really comes to mind. I still do things sometimes, but “genuinely interested” feels like a lot. I’m not sure.
Over the past two weeks, have you found yourself feeling like you can’t enjoy or take pleasure in things you used to enjoy, even things that used to make you happy?
I’m not sure. I guess… maybe a little, but I haven’t really been paying attention to it like that. Things just kind of feel the same.
Can you think of any activity or hobby that you used to enjoy, even a little, in the past? If so, when was the last time you felt any enjoyment doing it?
I don’t really know. Maybe I used to like watching stuff or playing games a bit, but I can’t think of a specific time recently where I was like… actually enjoying it. It’s kind of hard to say.
Can you say for sure that you no longer feel any pleasure or interest in activities you used to enjoy, even ones that seemed to matter to you before?
I don’t think I can say that for sure. It’s more like… I don’t really notice much either way. Maybe some things still feel okay, but I can’t really point to anything.
Can you recall feeling a clear loss of interest or pleasure in things you used to care about, even if just a little, in the past few weeks?
Not clearly, no. I mean… I know I haven’t been that into things, but I can’t really say I noticed a definite loss or anything. It’s just kind of been… flat, I guess.
How long has this flat, heavy feeling been going on? Was there ever a time in the past when you felt clearly better for a while, or has it been more or less continuous?

It’s been… a little over two years, I think. Maybe about two years and a couple months. It started around when that dashboard project at work kind of put me in the spotlight. Since then it’s been pretty continuous, I guess.
Have you had a depressed mood most of the time, even if it wasn’t severe, for most days over the past two years without a clear break of at least two months where you felt clearly better?

Yeah… I think so. It’s not always intense, but most days I’ve had this kind of flat, heavy feeling. Even when things are fine or people are decent to me, I still feel down… kind of empty. I don’t think there’s been a real two-month stretch where it lifted.
Have you found that you no longer take any pleasure or interest in things you used to enjoy, even a little, for most days over the past two years?
I don’t know if I’d say I take no pleasure in things. It’s more like everything feels muted. I still do stuff sometimes, but I’m not sure I can call it a clear loss, exactly.
Can you say that, for most days over the past two years, you’ve experienced a noticeable loss of interest or pleasure in most activities, even things you used to enjoy?
I’m not sure I’d say it’s most activities, no. Things feel kind of dulled down, but I haven’t really noticed a clear… loss of interest in everything or anything like that.
Over the past two years, have you noticed even a slight decrease in your interest or pleasure in activities you used to enjoy, even if it wasn’t a complete loss?
Maybe a little, yeah… but it’s hard for me to separate. I still do some things, I just don’t get as much out of them, I guess.
Can you recall any specific activity or moment in the past two weeks where you felt a noticeable loss of interest or pleasure in something you used to enjoy?
I can’t really think of a specific moment like that from the last couple weeks. Nothing stands out, I guess.
Would you say that, even if your mood has varied a little, you have not had a clear period of two months or more where you felt consistently better or back to normal during the past two years?

Yeah… I’d say that. It’s been pretty steady for about two years, maybe a little over—like two years and a couple months. Since that dashboard project at work, when I got kind of put in the spotlight. I don’t think I’ve had a stretch where I felt fully back to normal.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt a loss of interest or pleasure in activities you used to enjoy, even if it was just for a few days in a row?
I’m not really sure. I mean, maybe a little here and there, but I can’t say there was a few days in a row where it clearly felt like that.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt less interested or less able to enjoy things you used to like, even just a little?
Maybe a little, but I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed anything clear enough to say for sure.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt a clear loss of interest or pleasure in activities you used to enjoy, even for a few days?
I don’t think so. I mean… not clearly. Maybe some days things feel kind of flat, but I wouldn’t say I’ve noticed a definite loss of interest for a few days.
Over the past two years, have you felt a clear loss of interest or pleasure in activities you used to enjoy, even if it was just for a few weeks at a time?
I don’t know… over that long, it’s hard to say. I wouldn’t say there were clear weeks where I just lost interest in things. Maybe things felt kind of dull sometimes, but I can’t really pin it down.
